---
title: "CDISCPILOT01 Safety Dashboard"
format:
  dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    nav-buttons: []
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
library(ggsurvfit)

arms <- c("Placebo", "Xanomeline Low Dose", "Xanomeline High Dose") # protocol order

# Both files are limited to the safety population; ADAE holds treatment-emergent events only
adsl <- read.csv("data/ADSL.csv") |>
  mutate(
    TRT01A = factor(TRT01A, levels = arms),
    TRTSDT = as.Date(TRTSDT),
    TRTEDT = as.Date(TRTEDT),
    LSTALVDT = as.Date(LSTALVDT)
  )
adae <- read.csv("data/ADAE.csv") |>
  mutate(TRT01A = factor(TRT01A, levels = arms), ASTDT = as.Date(ASTDT))

arm_n <- count(adsl, TRT01A, name = "N")
n_with_teae <- n_distinct(adae$USUBJID)
n_severe <- n_distinct(adae$USUBJID[adae$AESEV == "SEVERE"])
n_serious <- n_distinct(adae$USUBJID[adae$AESER == "Y"])
```

# Overview

## Row {height=20%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Subjects treated"
list(icon = "people", color = "primary", value = nrow(adsl))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "With at least one TEAE"
list(
     icon = "clipboard2-pulse",
     color = "warning",
     value = sprintf("%d (%.0f%%)", n_with_teae, 100 * n_with_teae / nrow(adsl))
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "With a severe TEAE"
list(icon = "exclamation-triangle", color = "danger", value = n_severe)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "With a serious TEAE"
list(icon = "hospital", color = "danger", value = n_serious)
```

## Row {height=80%}

### Column {width=45%}

```{r}
#| title: "Most frequent TEAEs, n (%)"
#| fill: false
top10 <- adae |>
  distinct(USUBJID, AEDECOD) |>
  count(AEDECOD, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  pull(AEDECOD)

adae |>
  filter(AEDECOD %in% top10) |>
  distinct(USUBJID, TRT01A, AEDECOD) |>
  count(AEDECOD, TRT01A, name = "n") |>
  complete(AEDECOD, TRT01A, fill = list(n = 0L)) |>
  left_join(arm_n, by = "TRT01A") |>
  mutate(cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, 100 * n / N)) |>
  select(AEDECOD, TRT01A, cell) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = TRT01A, values_from = cell) |>
  mutate(AEDECOD = factor(AEDECOD, levels = top10)) |>
  arrange(AEDECOD) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(AEDECOD = "Preferred term") |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = "small")
```

### Column {width=55%}

```{r}
#| title: "Time to first TEAE"
#| fill: false
first_teae <- adae |>
  group_by(USUBJID) |>
  summarise(teae_date = min(ASTDT), .groups = "drop")

tte <- adsl |>
  left_join(first_teae, by = "USUBJID") |>
  mutate(
    event = as.integer(!is.na(teae_date)),
    end_date = if_else(!is.na(TRTEDT), TRTEDT + 30, LSTALVDT), # censor 30 days after last dose
    time = pmax(
      1,
      as.numeric(if_else(event == 1, teae_date, end_date) - TRTSDT) + 1
    )
  )

survfit2(Surv(time, event) ~ TRT01A, data = tte) |>
  ggsurvfit() +
  add_confidence_interval() +
  labs(x = "Days since first dose", y = "Probability of no TEAE")
```

# Listing

```{r}
#| title: "Severe or serious TEAEs"
adae |>
  filter(AESEV == "SEVERE" | AESER == "Y") |>
  transmute(
    `Subject ID` = USUBJID,
    Arm = TRT01A,
    `Preferred term` = AEDECOD,
    Onset = ASTDT,
    Severity = AESEV,
    Serious = AESER,
    Relationship = AEREL
  ) |>
  arrange(`Subject ID`, Onset) |>
  gt() |>
  sub_missing(missing_text = "—") |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = "small")
```
